stories.detail: 2nd - 2 off the pace

stories.detail: Off the stick (3) and 6th - proper ball-striking

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 16, 17 & 18

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 15-18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: The Null Hypothesis
stories.detail: 6 twos on holes 13-18 - the scorecard is a flatline

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Spot Fires
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ scattered through the round - keeps finding ways to score

stories.title: The Three-Point Farmer
stories.detail: 5 3-pointers+ harvested from the round - relentless

stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Pristine
stories.detail: Zero wipes from 17 holes - the scorer has not written a zero yet

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 17 & 18

stories.title: Jekyll & Hyde
stories.detail: 11 on the front, 19 on the back - two different golfers

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 19 on the front, 9 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 12, 13 & 14 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 15, back nine 8 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 5 wipes in 18 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 14 & 15 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: The Grind
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 3, 4 & 5

stories.title: Plot Hole

comingLast.roast: finished on 22 - his mates have formed a guard at the exit
one decent hole (5 points) and he slips the blue ball noose onto Forsyth
4 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
3 to play, 2 to find - the gallery (the bar) is invested
at 1.4 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
safe by 1 - unless Forsyth finds form, in which case, gulp
